body:
Thanks for the report! This looks like a duplicate of #9403, the existing enhancement request to detect missing fine-grained PAT permissions and give users a clearer message about what scope is missing. Your specific symptom (unhelpful `Resource not accessible by personal access token` errors for `statusCheckRollup` fields on `gh pr view`) also matches the previously reported and closed #12597.

For context: `gh pr view`'s default field set unconditionally requests `statusCheckRollup` (see [`defaultFields` in `pkg/cmd/pr/view/view.go`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/8db3c3107a174c51de4758f53d5b27911650931b/pkg/cmd/pr/view/view.go#L92-L95)), and today there's no special-casing of "Resource not accessible by personal access token" GraphQL errors for PR/issue queries to turn them into an actionable message pointing at the missing token permission — unlike the existing handling for ProjectsV2 fields (see [`ProjectsV2IgnorableError` in `api/queries_projects_v2.go`](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/8db3c3107a174c51de4758f53d5b27911650931b/api/queries_projects_v2.go#L162-L176)), which simply ignores such errors rather than surfacing guidance. I'm suggesting `duplicate` and the `gh-pr` command label; please follow #9403 for updates.
